title: Observability: ioctl_init silently returns -EOPNOTSUPP when sess_init is NULL
description: crypto2dev_fd.c:688-692: when ops->sess_init is NULL (a provider registered an algo_ops without a sess_init callback), ioctl_init calls module_put and returns -EOPNOTSUPP with no log message. There is no way to tell from the ring buffer that a provider was found but its sess_init vtable entry was absent. This is distinct from 'no provider found' (-ENOENT) and from 'fips_gate rejected' (-EACCES) but is the only ioctl_init failure path that emits no log. File:line: crypto2dev_fd.c:688.
